# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make participation in Dhamma Echo respectful and harassment-free for everyone, regardless of background, identity, experience, or belief.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, patient, and specific.
- Critique ideas and code, not people.
- Respect religious and cultural material represented by the catalogue.
- Do not use project spaces for harassment, threats, discrimination, or unwanted promotion.
- Protect private and sensitive information.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove content or participation that violates these standards. Report conduct issues privately through the maintainer contact configured for the repository. Maintainers will review reports in good faith and avoid unnecessary disclosure.
